name: app-factory
description: Reusable Claude Code skills extracted from OrthoZ: Laravel app foundation, feature modules, CI quality gates and VPS deployment.

plugins.name: app-foundation
plugins.description: Start a new production-grade Laravel app: bootstrap with quality gates, RBAC with atomic permissions, user profile, database-driven settings & branding, Blade design system.

plugins.name: app-modules
plugins.description: À-la-carte feature modules: audit/GDPR, PWA offline shell, scan input, CRUD resource recipe, email sequences, AI assistant, admin observability, read-only sync connector, onboarding, roadmap.

plugins.name: app-delivery
plugins.description: Ship it: blocking CI pipeline, VPS provisioning for one more app, and a parameterized deploy pipeline (continuous, scheduled or manual) with DB backup, health check and auto-rollback.

plugins.name: app-design
plugins.description: Design discipline: the choregraphe agent defines the minimal motion choreography of every new page before it exists; a hook refuses to create a page without it.
